title: This week's hottest physics papers on arXiv

sections.title: Coherent error threshold for quantum LDPC codes
sections.abstract: The authors prove a nonzero code-capacity threshold for local coherent and local channel noise in general quantum LDPC code families with logarithmic distance, with logical error suppressed exponentially below threshold.
sections.claimed_result: A constant coherent-noise threshold for qLDPC codes with distance Omega(log n), with exponential suppression under optimal and minimum-weight recovery.
sections.caveat: The theorem concerns local noise and specified code families, not arbitrary correlated device noise or a demonstrated hardware threshold.

sections.title: Locally optimized variational evolution for quantum many-body systems
sections.abstract: A variational evolution based on local reduced-density-matrix costs is demonstrated on Quantinuum H2 and IBM Heron processors.
sections.claimed_result: Local optimization retains short-time coherent dynamics while exploiting thermalization at later times and tolerating shot and hardware noise.
sections.caveat: The demonstrations are proof-of-principle and scalability outside the tested regimes is not established.

sections.title: The axion mass in the post-inflationary scenario in a minimal scaling model
sections.abstract: Large classical-field simulations of post-inflationary strings and domain walls infer a minimal-model dark-matter axion mass of 17.46(84) microeV.
sections.claimed_result: An axion target mass of 17.46(84) microeV and haloscope frequency of 4.22(20) GHz in the minimal model.
sections.caveat: The prediction is model-dependent and is not an axion detection.

sections.title: Experimental demonstration of finite-size general security via discrete-modulated CVQKD with real time postprocessing
sections.abstract: A discrete-modulated CVQKD system generates composable secret keys against general attacks with finite blocks of roughly 10^6 rounds.
sections.claimed_result: A real-time QPSK CVQKD implementation combining entropy accumulation and conic optimization demonstrates finite-size composable security.
sections.caveat: Security remains conditional on complete characterization of channel, calibration, and device side-channel models.

sections.title: Proof of Shor's conjecture on the accessible information of quantum dichotomies
sections.abstract: The paper proves that accessible information of any two-state quantum ensemble is attained by a projective measurement.
sections.claimed_result: A longstanding conjecture is settled in arbitrary dimension, with a convex formulation for dichotomy optimization.
sections.caveat: The theorem applies to two-state ensembles and does not make the general ensemble problem convex.

sections.title: Euclid: Galaxy cluster detection through the weak lensing effect - algorithm assessment and selection
sections.abstract: The Euclid Consortium compares nine weak-lensing cluster finders in 1200 square degrees of Euclid-like simulations.
sections.claimed_result: Combining selected methods can exceed 70 percent completeness for low-redshift, high-mass clusters at about 90 percent purity.
sections.caveat: Performance is simulation-based rather than a result from Euclid flight data.

sections.title: Parisi Formula for the ground state energy of quantum p-Spin Hamiltonians
sections.abstract: The author proves existence of the limiting ground-state energy for quantum p-local spin-glass Hamiltonians and gives a Parisi-type variational formula.
sections.claimed_result: The limiting product-state energy is characterized for every p greater than or equal to 2, with universality for broad non-Gaussian interactions.
sections.caveat: The result is an asymptotic characterization, not a finite-size algorithm or material-specific experimental prediction.
